protocol.reference_temperature: (t + tsht) / 2; both sensors required and valid
protocol.point_target: Closest valid reading within five minutes of hourly interval end; not an hourly mean
protocol.rain_target: Six valid ten-minute intervals, nominal clock alignment within 90 seconds, rf agrees with counter delta times 0.28 mm; incomplete hours unavailable
protocol.other_present_flag: E8 is soil temperature; it does not exclude ambient temperature, SHT humidity or rain
protocol.training_reference: Original X66 t/h stream retained in frozen V2/V3/V4 experiments
protocol.interpretation: Accuracy is measured against the user-requested combined temperature and SHT humidity reference, not a claim of either sensor being calibrated truth
